library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Add `testAnnotationProcessor "io.micronaut:micronaut-inject-java:5.0.0"` to the generated build.gradle's dependencies block (same version as the resolved artifact). Micronaut's DI is driven entirely by compile-time annotation processing: without this processor, classes annotated with @Inject/@Singleton/@Factory/@ConfigurationProperties compile but produce no generated BeanDefinition/BeanIntrospection classes, so micronaut-inject's SPI types are never implemented and no reachability metadata would ever be hit. This mirrors the existing io.micronaut:micronaut-core and io.micronaut:micronaut-context test scaffolds in tests/src/io.micronaut/, which both declare this exact testAnnotationProcessor dependency for the same reason.
risks: The deterministic-setup schema only accepts testImplementation/testRuntimeOnly/implementation/runtimeOnly scopes, so the testAnnotationProcessor addition cannot be applied automatically by the driver and depends on the generation step following this guidance verbatim — verify the final build.gradle actually declares it before trusting a green local Gradle/Native Image run.

io.micronaut:micronaut-context:5.0.0 and io.micronaut:micronaut-inject-java:5.0.0 are assumed to exist as lockstep siblings of the already-supported io.micronaut:micronaut-core:5.0.0 in this repo; confirm resolution during generateMetadata/pullAllowedDockerImages since this sandbox had no network access to verify directly against Maven Central.
